create_MVDataset: create an MVDataset instance with a ROOT path, split mode, and configurable number of render views
review_MVDataset_init: review the MVDataset __init__ method to understand how HDF5 scene data is loaded and split into train/test sets
test_MVDataset_get_views: test the MVDataset _get_views method to verify it returns correctly ordered inference and render view dictionaries
refactor_MVDataset_split_logic: refactor the MVDataset split logic to support custom train/test/vis split ratios beyond the default 0.9 threshold
summarize_MVDataset_len: summarize the MVDataset __len__ method which returns scene count multiplied by inference views when ref_all is enabled
